title: Model Manifest
description: Per-model manifest declaring identity, inputs, outputs, UQ contract, invocation, lineage, and discoverability metadata. Co-located with the model executable and a sibling model_card.md. Validated at server registry-load.

id.description: Stable identifier; used in URLs, run records, and registry keys. Lowercase ASCII, must start with a letter.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in catalog cards and reports.

spec_version.description: Manifest-spec (schema) version this model is authored against, as MAJOR.MINOR. Optional and additive; an absent value is treated as "1.0" (the v1 spec). The GUI loads any manifest whose MAJOR is <= its supported maximum (minor bumps are additive and back-compatible) and rejects a higher MAJOR loud at registry load (back-compat policy; see docs/gui-design.md decision 15). Distinct from `version`, which is the model's own semver.

contact.description: Contact for the team (email or chat handle).

domain.description: Engineering domain (e.g., thermomechanical_fatigue, vibration, flow). Drives faceted catalog browse.

modality.description: Coarse input-to-output shape, for catalog facets.

tags.description: Free-form tags for catalog facets and search.

analysis_type.description: Plain-language analysis category for non-expert discovery (e.g. "fatigue life", "vibration response", "flow rate"). Optional and additive. Populated dynamically into the catalog's primary browse axis exactly like `domain`/`tags` — NOT a hardcoded vocabulary (design §13 decision 16). Phrase it the way a non-CAE/ML user with an analysis in mind would.

purpose.description: One-line statement, in plain language a non-CAE/ML reader can understand, of what the model predicts.

when_to_use.description: Plain-language guidance on appropriate use cases, written for a non-expert who has an analysis in mind. Drives non-expert discovery; an empty value draws an advisory warn at load (never a rejection).

when_not_to_use.description: Plain-language guidance on inappropriate use cases. Surfaced in reports.

primary_inputs.description: Input names shown as default columns in the history table.

primary_outputs.description: Output names shown as default columns in the history table.

executable.description: Path to the model executable, relative to the manifest file.

timeout_s.description: Hard timeout after which the server kills the .exe and records an error.

expected_runtime_s.description: Informational estimate shown in the UI.

batch_supported.description: If true, the .exe accepts mode=batch and emits one JSON output per input row.

training_data_version.description: Identifier or version tag for the training dataset.

training_date.description: ISO-8601 date the model was trained.

metrics.description: Free-form map of metric_name -> value. At least one metric required.

retrain_cadence.description: Free-form description of retrain schedule (e.g., quarterly, on-demand).

model_card.description: Path to the model card markdown file, relative to the manifest file. Required, validated at registry load (front-matter + 9 mandatory H2 sections).

examples.description: Pre-filled input sets for the model detail page 'Try this' buttons.

units.description: Display units. The GUI lets the user pick a compatible display unit.

canonical_units.description: Units the .exe expects. The GUI converts user input from display units to canonical before sending.

range.description: [min, max] in canonical units. Values outside warn the user but do not block submission.

file_kind.description: Required for type=file. Filters the file picker.

default.description: Pre-filled in the auto-form when present.

viewer.description: Selects the React viewer component. field_contour is reserved for a downstream phase.

form.description: Default UQ form. Per-output blocks may override.

per_output.description: Map from output field name to its UQ field declarations. Must cover every output.

empirical_coverage.description: Achieved coverage on the holdout set. Drives the trust badge.

expected_hint.description: Optional plain-language hint shown next to the Try this button.
